selected_model.loss: masked focal BCE + Dice with valid-pixel normalization
selected_model.post_processing: threshold plus connected-component object analysis; no FOV mask available
selected_model.preprocessing: RGB resize to 768x768; ImageNet mean/std normalization; synchronized retinal-safe augmentation
selected_model.training_data: IDRiD official segmentation training split, 54 images only
selected_model.validation_strategy: 5-fold development CV on the 54-image training split; duplicate-aware fixed seed

status_reason: The model is frozen and measurable, but the small development set, low microaneurysm Dice, missing FOV masks, incomplete soft-exudate annotations, and lack of clinical validation prevent a production or clinical-readiness claim.
